svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 90 mm lengths of 40 x 6 mm bar; square and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bar hole: 22.5 mm on the centre line, centre 70 mm up from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: board end. Drill a pilot, open with a step drill or hole saw,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: file to a sliding fit on the 22.2 mm handlebar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grub screw: drill 4.2 mm down the centre line from the top end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the bar hole and tap M5; an M5 grub screw locks the bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot bolt holes: two 6.6 mm, 12 mm up, 10 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: a 40 mm foot bolts to the outside face of each post; the posts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand 230 mm apart (centres) with the bar through both.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bar slides through both posts by hand and locks with
